The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numeric values. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations in the 'Task' worksheet are broken.
